title: Daily Streak & Habit Tracker
idea: Build a calm personal habit tracker with a single screen for daily check-ins, current and best streaks, a 7-day completion ring, and optional reminder times.
problemStatement: Build a calm personal habit tracker with a single screen for daily check-ins, current and best streaks, a 7-day completion ring, and optional reminder times.

problem_brief.title: Problem Brief — Daily Streak & Habit Tracker

approaches.name: SQLite-Backed Daily Ledger
approaches.summary: Store habits and per-date check-in rows in SQLite with deterministic streak aggregation.
approaches.bestFor: Reliable multi-tab persistence, instant check-ins, and clean streak history queries.
pros: Unique (habit_id, completed_on) index prevents duplicate check-ins
Persists across browser restarts and device previews
Simple REST endpoints for toggle, create, and archive
cons: Requires thin Hono API routes for check-in mutations
risks: Local date formatting must use YYYY-MM-DD consistently

approaches.name: Browser-Only LocalStorage
approaches.summary: Store the entire habit array and date map in window.localStorage.
approaches.bestFor: Static prototypes that never touch a backend.
cons: Data disappears when browser site data is cleared
Cannot share state across preview origins
risks: Silent storage quota errors on mobile browsers

approaches.name: Event-Sourced Habit Log
approaches.summary: Append every check, uncheck, and schedule change to an immutable event stream.
pros: Full historical replay of every toggle
cons: Unnecessary projection complexity for a personal habit tracker
Higher query cost as history grows
risks: Projection bugs when habits change cadence
